description: Find days of The Championships, Wimbledon with Debenture tickets for sale, with the cheapest price for the party size. Each day is listed per show court (Centre Court or No. 1 Court). Prices are per ticket in GBP and are what the buyer pays: there is no buyer fee. Returns a buy_url per day: give it to the person, who signs in and pays on the site.

include_sold_out.description: Also list upcoming days with nothing for sale.

round.description: Words to match in the day's name, e.g. "final", "quarter", "2nd round", "doubles".

name: search_events
title: Search Wimbledon days and tickets
